rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure with no third parties involved is classic property damage to real property.
claim_summary: Wind last weekend blew four shingles off the back porch overhang; no interior leaks or other damage. Policyholder estimates $400 repair cost. Low-severity claim; property_damage coverage is active under POL-1006 (homeowners_premium, $2,500 deductible).

case_facts.description: wind blew four shingles off overhang above back porch
